---
description: "Generate/update docs/handoff.md at the end of a session"
agent: handoff-writer
---
Read [the shared planning workflow](../instructions/planning.instructions.md) and follow its Handoff section; no extra wording after `/handoff` is needed. Summarize this session and update [docs/handoff.md](../../docs/handoff.md) using its template (State / Decisions since last session / Open questions / Blockers / Next), carrying forward unresolved non-blocking "Open questions" unchanged. Update the status of any [docs/tasks.md](../../docs/tasks.md) rows confirmed complete this session to `✅ Done · <date>`. Mark `⛔ Blocked · <reason>` on any task that could not be finished, including one stuck on an unanswered blocking question — if that question blocks all remaining work, not just one task, still mark a task row Blocked (not only this file) so the Stop hook's detection fires. If a task is paused only on a forward test dependency (not a true blocker), leave it `🔄 In Progress · <date> (depends on T0XX)` and list the pair together under "Next". Only report progress that is verifiable from the diff/tests, not assumed. Never approve planning or modify its snapshots.
